newsitem.title: ITALY: San Paolo considering Telecom stake-paper.
newsitem.headline: San Paolo considering Telecom stake-paper.

text.p: Italy's largest banking group San Paolo di Torino is interested in taking a stake in the newly merged Telecom Italia which is set for privatisation this autumn, said San Paolo's chairman, Gianni Merlini.

In an interview in Milan's financial daily Il Sole 24 Ore on Wednesday, Merlini added that the question of whether to buy a stake in Telecom Italia will be discussed at the banking group's next board meeting in September.
"The next board meeting will discuss the entry into the capital of the telecoms group," he said in the interview.
No-one was immediately available for comment at San Paolo.
